reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fixed kube-virt-related rules not being removed by istio-clean-iptables tool", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The istio-clean-iptables tool will now successfully remove kube-virt-related iptables rules, whereas previously such rules were not being removed.

proposed.statement: The istio-clean-iptables tool now correctly removes kube-virt-related iptables rules.
